Question

Wording 1: survey years 1998, 1999, 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2013, 2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2023

The RNI reflects the final disposition from the case management system at the end of the fielding period; it is not updated to reflect later information (e.g., deaths). COMMENT: Reason for non interview

Notes

Titles by year: REASON FOR NON INTERVIEW (1998); REASON FOR NON INTERVIEW - CASE DISPOSITION (1999, 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2013, 2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2023) The codebook states no universe for 1998. Labels that differ by year (beyond case): 90: 'Unlocatable' -> 'Final Unlocatable' (2001); 94: 'Respondent too ill' -> 'Respondent too ill/handicapped' (2001); 99: 'Other' -> 'Other Noninterview' (2001); 90: 'Final Unlocatable' -> 'Unlocatable' (2002); 93: 'Language barrier' -> 'R inaccessible' (2002); 94: 'Respondent too ill/handicapped' -> 'Respondent too ill' (2002); 99: 'Other Noninterview' -> 'Other' (2002); 80: 'OOS/Deceased' -> 'Prior Deceased Blocked' (2003); 90: 'Unlocatable' -> 'Final unlocatable' (2003); 92: 'Technical problem' -> 'Gatekeeper Refusal' (2003); 98: 'NIR/Deceased' -> 'OOS/Deceased' (2003); 99: 'Other' -> 'Other Noninterview' (2003); 90: 'Final unlocatable' -> 'Unlocatable' (2004); 99: 'Other Noninterview' -> 'Other' (2004); 90: 'Unlocatable' -> 'Final unlocatable' (2006); 93: 'R inaccessible' -> 'R - inaccessible' (2006); 94: 'Respondent too ill' -> 'Respondent too ill/handicapped' (2006); 98: 'OOS/Deceased' -> 'Deceased' (2006); 99: 'Other' -> 'Other noninterview' (2007); 93: 'R - inaccessible' -> 'Respondent inaccessible' (2008); 99: 'Other noninterview' -> 'Other' (2008); 80: 'Prior deceased blocked' -> 'Prior deceased blocked (not fielded)' (2013); 94: 'Respondent too ill/handicapped' -> 'R too ill/handicapped' (2013); 98: 'Deceased' -> 'Deceased (current round)' (2013)
